dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: #{M#Sir, ma'am}{F#Good ladies}, I wish you a good morning, afternoon, and evening!

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: My name is Maillardet, a researcher with the Fontaine Research Institute. I believe the two of you are here to witness the Icewind Suite?

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: According to Mr. Bossuet's original plan, Coppelius and Coppelia are clockwork meka dedicated to the art of dance.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: But after I took over the project, I also added in some of my understanding of Pneumousia...

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: So as you can see, not only are they good at dancing, but they are also highly capable fighters!

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: However, I believe that there's still much room for improvement. We require large amounts of experimental data to further increase their combat prowess.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: I might have gotten too passionate during the development phase — and from that came two different combat modes for Coppelius and Coppelia based on the differences between Pneuma and Ousia...

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: They are <color=#00E1FFFF>Dirge of Coppelia</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>Nemesis of Coppelius</color>. That is to say, we'll need two times the research data!

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: As long as we can iterate on them smoothly, the joy of our success will be doubled.

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: And the coming of that joy now rests upon your shoulders, brave warrior!

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: #What do you say, bold {M#sir}{F#ma'am}? Would you be willing to join our machines in their dance?

dialogues.speaker: Maillardet
dialogues.text: The dance floor is always open for you.
